newsitem.title: USA: Vidamed gets FDA clearance for TUNA system.
newsitem.headline: Vidamed gets FDA clearance for TUNA system.

text.p: Vidamed Inc said it has received 510k clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) to market its TransUrethral Needle Ablation (TUNA) system in the U.S.
A spokeswoman said the TUNA system was designed to treat symptomatic benign prostatic hyperplasia (enlarged prostate).
The TUNA procedure uses localized heat to treat the prostate, is performed by a urologist in an office setting and does not require general anesthesia.

The company said in a statement that clinical studies have demonstrated that treatment with the TUNA system offers improved urine flow, excellent symptomatic relief and minimal side effects compared with transurethral resection of the prostate adding that no incontinence or impotence was observed in the clinical trials.
The company said that in terms of relieving the symptoms of an enlarged prostate TUNA is as good as surgery.
